answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 5-copper bond and keeps an ember of compute burning: a proof-of-work ping each epoch proving one live machine. A beacon spot-checks 10% of identities per epoch, demanding a fresh heartbeat within minutes. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 45 coins over a 20-epoch horizon = 45,000; one honest agent pays 45, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards.
